🎭 Calling Card: NASA Space Apps 2026

“The Red Planet holds the treasure. We’re here to take it, and share it with everyone.”

We are Phantom Synkro, a crew of three from SynkroLab, an open-source hardware and scientific democratization lab from Bogotá, Colombia. Our philosophy is simple: knowledge and technology shouldn’t belong to a few. So we build tools, make them open, and put them in everyone’s hands, a bit like Phantom Thieves of science. 🃏

Time to take the heart of Mars. ❤️‍🔥
